_note_apiBase: The API the suno.com SPA actually calls. api.suno.ai 503s from this network and auth.suno.com/api/v1/auth/refresh 404s — both were probed. studio-api-prod.suno.com answers, but only with the Bearer token the SPA attaches itself.
_note_cookiesFile: Cookie jar exported from a browser logged into suno.com. Netscape or JSON format. SECRET — keep it out of git (see .gitignore). The jar's __session access token is usually stale on export; the SPA refreshes it server-side from the __client refresh cookie, which is why the browser route works even when the pasted access token is expired.
_note_userDataDir: Browser profile for the Suno backend. Separate from the Midjourney profile so the two never fight over one Chromium instance.
_note_port: CDP debugging port. Pick anything not already used by the MJ backend (9444).

paths._note_webBrowserBin: Browser binary. MUST run headed — suno.com loads Cloudflare Turnstile and hCaptcha, which challenge headless Chromium.

_note_headless: Run Chrome headed. MEASURED 2026-10-21: the generation captcha (Cloudflare Turnstile) does NOT solve in headless Chrome — the widget renders but no token arrives, and the request dies at 'captcha token timed out' after 45s. Headed, the same widget returns a ~730-char token in ~2s. The headless flag is still implemented in lib/mj-submitter.js (launchChrome gains a headless argument) and is re-verified on every run, so it fails loudly instead of silently degrading.
